raw_annotations.proposed_function: C-terminal proline-rich (HPQ-rich) intrinsically disordered region unique to BRD4-L, involved in partner association and targeted by antibodies and perturbations.
raw_annotations.evidence: Among BET family proteins, the C-terminal proline-rich (sometimes referred to as HPQ-rich for histidine/proline/glutamine-rich) region is unique to BRD4-L.

raw_annotations.proposed_function: Intrinsically disordered region (IDR) of phospho-BRD4 targeted by small-molecule inhibitors to alter specific protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks.
raw_annotations.evidence: the discovery of a new class of small-molecule inhibitors targeting an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) of phospho-BRD4 to alter specific protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks without globally perturbing transcription programs and chromatin landscapes

raw_annotations.proposed_function: IDR segment (pNPS) that binds internal IDR-targeting compounds (e.g., 14 and 90) with comparable affinity in vitro.
raw_annotations.evidence: While the internal IDR-targeting compounds (e.g., 14 and 90) appear to bind pNPS of full-length proteins or an IDR-only segment derived from purified recombinant BRD4-L, BRD4-S, BRD3, and BRD2 with comparable affinities in vitro
